sig: [[["A", "Hi all, it's Megan from the IT security team, with a reminder about the policy changes we announced last month."], ["A", "From the fifteenth, all passwords must be at least fourteen characters long, up from eight."], ["A", "You'll also be required to change them every ninety days rather than every sixty."], ["A", "So, longer passwords, but fewer changes; it's not all bad news."], ["A", "The bigger change is two-factor authentication."], ["A", "Every account that can access customer data must have it switched on by the end of this month."], ["A", "After that, accounts without it will be locked automatically, and you'll need to raise a ticket to get back in."], ["A", "We recommend using the Authenticator app rather than text messages, since it's more secure and works without phone signal."], ["A", "Setup takes about five minutes, and there's a step-by-step guide on the intranet."], ["A", "If you'd rather have someone walk you through it, we're running drop-in sessions on Wednesday and Friday afternoons in room 3C."], ["A", "And please don't share your codes with anyone, including people claiming to be from IT. We'll never ask for them."]], {"A": "F-AU"}]
